privacySection1Body: Your name, phone number, email, precise location while requesting or taking a ride, trip history and payment data.
privacySection2Body: To create accounts, match you with drivers, track active rides, handle payments and provide support. We do not sell personal data.
privacySection3Body: Necessary trip details (pickup, destination, route) are shared with the driver who accepts your ride. Data is not shared with third parties for advertising.
privacySection4Body: Your precise location is used during an active ride or when you are finding a pickup point. It is not tracked in the background.
privacySection5Body: Trip data is kept for 12 months and you may request access or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting support.
privacySection6Body: Data is transmitted securely and stored with restricted access. You are responsible for keeping your login details safe.
privacySection7Body: Contact privacy inquiries by email. Our current support email is shown under Help & support.

termsSection1Body: By creating an account or using FEM C@BS you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the app. These terms are in draft form until finalised before launch.
termsSection2Body: FEM C@BS provides passenger ride-hailing services. A passenger is at least 18 years old. Accounts are personal, your details must be accurate, and you must not misuse the app or interfere with other users.
termsSection3Body: Ride prices are shown before booking based on distance. Final fares may differ when the official price engine is connected. You may cancel before a driver accepts; cancellation policies will be shown when they become active.
termsSection4Body: Payment is required for every completed ride. Accepted methods are displayed at booking. Unpaid balances may block new rides until settled.
termsSection5Body: You are responsible for activity on your account. If you suspect unauthorized use, contact support immediately. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms.
termsSection6Body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, FEM C@BS is not liable for indirect or incidental damages. Rides are provided by independent drivers on the platform at the time of travel.
termsSection7Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Updated terms will be available in the app and take effect when published.
